thread:
devin_eng: initiating rolling deploy llm-router v6 -> v6 (canary). plan: enable llm_route_v6=10% for canary-eu at 22:00 UTC, auto-ramp to 30% after 25m if healthy. release notes tag: kv-cache-bounds.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: deploy/llm-router/v6 -> canary-eu. CI green, smoke ok. link: https://ci.redwood/llm-router/7890
maria_pm: quick reminder: set session_sticky=true for canary to reduce cross-cohort noise.
sre_oncall: watching memory+gc. threshold: p95 mem +5% sustained -> auto-hold.
deploy-bot: 22:05 UTC: ramp to 10% complete. telemetry: latency nominal, errors 0.0x, mem +2% avg.
devin_eng: seeing minor heap drift on 3 hosts (canary-eu-2/5/9). collecting heapdumps.
sre_oncall: 22:12 UTC: canary-eu-5 p95 mem +5.4% and GC pause spikes. issuing manual HOLD.
deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. snapshot saved. rollback command available: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-eu --force
maria_pm: soak 10m while dev triages, but be ready to rollback.
devin_eng: heapdiff shows buffer retention in kv-cache for seq_len > 1024. prefer rollback for safety.
sre_oncall: 22:20 UTC: canary-eu-9 crosses +6% p95 mem. executing rollback now.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-eu --force
ops_robin: unpinning sticky sessions and setting flag llm_route_v6=0 for canary cohort. /flag set llm_route_v6 0 --cohort=canary-eu --reason="mem regression"
release_comm: updated release notes: "v6 canary rollback due to memory regression in kv-cache; triage in progress."
sre_oncall: rollback complete at 22:28 UTC. canary traffic back to v5. no user-facing errors observed. lowering canary alert thresholds for next attempt.
maria_pm: action items: dev to propose micropatch, run large-seq perf, schedule muted reattempt with extra tracing. keeping this thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
